log.notes: The round body is compressed into a 16x16 ball. The big cyan eye is ringed in black on the green head, and the head is split from the orange body by a black line. The chunky 3-px olive gun-nose and the separate scope block are kept, while the wing nub, tail and breastplate are reduced to tiny hints with tucked feet below.

I rounded the silhouette into a ball, with the green head in the upper left and a diagonal black line splitting it from the orange body. The eye now has a thinner ring, so its cyan reads bigger. I also removed the stray pixel and kept the chunky gun-nose, the separate scope, the wing nub and the tucked legs.

I made the gun-nose 3 px wide so it reads chunkier and made the wing khaki so it stands apart from the orange body. I also added a small green breastplate hint and a clear tucked leg with feet. The big eye, the separate scope and the dark head/body split line are unchanged.

The eye and chunky gun-nose dominate, while a heavy seam clearly separates the teal head from the red body. The breastplate was omitted and the vestigial wing and tail reduced to compact silhouette cues.

I enlarged and clarified the bright eye, rebuilt the gun-nose as a thick barrel with a dark muzzle, and gave the scope a cleaner outlined block. A continuous dark seam now separates the teal head from the red body, while compact wings, tail, and tucked feet preserve the concept’s silhouette.

I enlarged the eye into the dominant focal mass and rebuilt the gun-nose as a clearly hollow, three-pixel-thick barrel. The scope, head, body, wings, tucked feet, and tiny tail now form cleaner outlined shapes, with a strong dark seam separating the teal head from the red body.
